description: This Java class implements a command strategy for deleting a datatable entry associated with a one-to-many relationship in a batch processing context within the Apache Fineract project. It parses the request URL to extract datatable, entity, and entry identifiers, then calls the corresponding API resource to perform the deletion, and formulates an appropriate batch response.

classes.name: DeleteDatatableEntryOneToManyCommandStrategy
classes.description: Implements command strategy to delete a datatable entry in a batch request, by delegating to DatatablesApiResource.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the delete operation by parsing URL parameters, invoking the DatatablesApiResource, and returning a BatchResponse.
